scheme_name: Coffee Development Programme in North Eastern Region: Quality Upgradation / Certification: Drying Yards
other_conditions: Applicant must not have availed benefits during the XII plan.
benefits_summary: 75% subsidy on drying yard construction, up to ₹15,000 for holdings up to 2 ha and up to ₹45,000 for holdings of 2 ha or more.
